title: Operations Manager (Product)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Manager (Product) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We’re looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing a point of view on specific fintech verticals and defining a cohesive long-term strategy for the company and product departments
  • Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, feeding information from the market back into company strategy and department roadmaps
  • Tracking and analysing competitive position and product performance globally
  • Helping scope and launch new verticals for the company
  • Defining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier university
  • A track record of outstanding achievement in different areas
  • 3+ years of experience in a strategy consulting, investment banking/PE/VC, or fast-growing technology company in a product or strategy role
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • A focus on customer-centric designs and solutions

Nice to have

  • A track record of building successful products (ideally financial) using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning

Compensation range

  • Krakow: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision.
  • Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs.
  • Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance.
  • Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations.
  • Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won’t be accepted.

  • Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40MBPS


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision.
  • Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs.
  • Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance.
  • Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations.
  • Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won’t be accepted.

  • Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40MBPS


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.
  • Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.



TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Hiring Specialist (Freelance)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hiring Specialist (Freelance) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Regional Mass Hiring Specialist / BPO Recruiter (Freelance)

Location: Remote, Brazil


Contract Type : Independent Contractor (PJ setup required)


About Thoth AI At Thoth AI, we are building the global data infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI. We require massive amounts of high-quality, localized data (speech, text, image) to train AI models. To achieve this, we are rapidly expanding our crowd-sourcing and freelance network across Latin America.


The Role We need an agile Volume Hiring Specialist and Community Builder . Your primary mission is to build robust, down-to-earth talent pipelines to rapidly fulfill large-scale data collection and annotation projects. If you know how to generate fast candidate traffic and manage micro-vendors in LATAM, this is for you.


What You Will Do

  • High-Volume Sourcing: Execute rapid hiring cycles (e.g., sourcing 50-100 freelance data annotators/speakers within days) using traditional and non-traditional channels.
  • Grassroots Traffic Generation: Dive deep into localized social media (Facebook groups, WhatsApp/Telegram communities), university forums, and regional gig-economy platforms to attract flexible workers.
  • Micro-Vendor Networking: Identify and build partnerships with local BPO agencies, small translation studios, or university student unions to act as our talent sub-nodes.
  • Fast-Paced Screening: Pre-screen large volumes of candidates for language proficiency and project availability, ensuring a seamless handover to our global delivery team.


Who You Are

  • Experience: You have a proven track record in Volume Hiring, BPO Recruitment, or Crowd-sourcing operations (experience with high-turnover/gig-worker recruitment is highly preferred).
  • Mindset: You are a \"hands-on\" executioner, not just a strategist. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment and aren't afraid of the grind of mass hiring.
  • Language: Bilingual in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus for covering LATAM).
  • Prefered Setup: Established as an Independent Contractor with a registered PJ entity in Brazil.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously with our Global HQ.

Seeking a freelance project that will allow you to work from home while making a difference in the world of technology? If you are someone who is passionate and enjoys staying ahead of the tech curve this part-time remote project with flexible working hours might be what you are looking for!


A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:

  • In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout
  • Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.



Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:

  • Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.


Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.


Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills, with full professional proficiency in English and Geman
  • Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Brazil
  • Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a
  • Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.
  • English CV
  • This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation


The estimated hourly earnings for this role is 6 USD. Payment is based on completed tasks, with the potential for higher earnings based on productivity.


Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Don’t worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!


Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Hiring Specialist (Freelance)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Hiring Specialist (Freelance) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Regional Mass Hiring Specialist / BPO Recruiter (Freelance)

Location: Remote, Brazil


Contract Type : Independent Contractor (PJ setup required)


About Thoth AI At Thoth AI, we are building the global data infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI. We require massive amounts of high-quality, localized data (speech, text, image) to train AI models. To achieve this, we are rapidly expanding our crowd-sourcing and freelance network across Latin America.


The Role We need an agile Volume Hiring Specialist and Community Builder . Your primary mission is to build robust, down-to-earth talent pipelines to rapidly fulfill large-scale data collection and annotation projects. If you know how to generate fast candidate traffic and manage micro-vendors in LATAM, this is for you.


What You Will Do

  • High-Volume Sourcing: Execute rapid hiring cycles (e.g., sourcing 50-100 freelance data annotators/speakers within days) using traditional and non-traditional channels.
  • Grassroots Traffic Generation: Dive deep into localized social media (Facebook groups, WhatsApp/Telegram communities), university forums, and regional gig-economy platforms to attract flexible workers.
  • Micro-Vendor Networking: Identify and build partnerships with local BPO agencies, small translation studios, or university student unions to act as our talent sub-nodes.
  • Fast-Paced Screening: Pre-screen large volumes of candidates for language proficiency and project availability, ensuring a seamless handover to our global delivery team.


Who You Are

  • Experience: You have a proven track record in Volume Hiring, BPO Recruitment, or Crowd-sourcing operations (experience with high-turnover/gig-worker recruitment is highly preferred).
  • Mindset: You are a \"hands-on\" executioner, not just a strategist. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment and aren't afraid of the grind of mass hiring.
  • Language: Bilingual in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a strong plus for covering LATAM).
  • Prefered Setup: Established as an Independent Contractor with a registered PJ entity in Brazil.
  • Autonomy: Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously with our Global HQ.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Head of Liquidity
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Liquidity em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business.


Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets.
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance.
  • Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.


FX & Trading Operations

  • Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows.
  • Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing.
  • Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics.
  • Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.


Counterparty & Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties.
  • Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews.
  • Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.


Risk & Governance

  • Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight.
  • Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks.
  • Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.


Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead and develop the liquidity function.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams.
  • Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.


Requirements

  • Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments.
  • Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners.
  • Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices.
  • Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics.
  • Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para ser um pilar técnico no desenvolvimento e evolução dos nossos produtos corporativos, com foco principal na criação da nossa nova plataforma interna de Recursos Humanos e Departamento Pessoal. Em um ambiente dinâmico de uma empresa de gestão de saúde, sua missão é atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de soluções de alto impacto.


Você liderará tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de um ecossistema completo que gerenciará a jornada dos nossos colaboradores, desde a admissão virtual e gestão de ponto eletrônico, até o processamento complexo da folha de pagamento. Além de escrever código escalável e de alta qualidade utilizando o ecossistema Node.js e React, você deverá liderar pelo exemplo, mentorar outros desenvolvedores e ditar os padrões de arquitetura da equipe.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código.
  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP):
  • Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros.
  • Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta.
  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).



Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto.
  • Foco no Usuário e Qualidade: Entender a criticidade financeira e humana de um sistema de DP/RH, responsabilizando-se pelo funcionamento impecável das regras de negócio.
  • Tradução de Requisitos: Facilidade para dialogar com especialistas de DP/RH para transformar leis e portarias em lógica matemática de software.
  • Gestão de Crise: Perfil analítico para lidar com gargalos ou bugs de forma ágil e fria, especialmente em momentos críticos (fechamento de folha).



Diferenciais


  • Experiência com React Native para desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em performance de aplicações e otimização de queries de banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento prévio em PHP e/ou Python para auxiliar na manutenção ou migração de sistemas legados.
  • Ter atuado em HRTechs ou possuir forte interesse no desenvolvimento de produtos para a área da saúde.



Contrato PJ

100% Remoto


E aí, topa o desafio?


Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: People Specialist - Payroll
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para People Specialist - Payroll em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Revolut’s People team shapes how we support our people and ensure a seamless experience every day. From onboarding to coaching and development, they partner with teams across the business to create a people-first environment that enables growth and success.

We're looking for a Payroll Specialist to provide the greatest support to our employees by delivering everyday payroll tasks globally and keeping the employment life cycle running smoothly.

You'll manage salaries, answer employee queries, and collaborate with third-party vendors, as well as contribute to building the infrastructure enabling Revolut's continuous growth.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para ser um pilar técnico no desenvolvimento e evolução dos nossos produtos corporativos, com foco principal na criação da nossa nova plataforma interna de Recursos Humanos e Departamento Pessoal. Em um ambiente dinâmico de uma empresa de gestão de saúde, sua missão é atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de soluções de alto impacto.


Você liderará tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de um ecossistema completo que gerenciará a jornada dos nossos colaboradores, desde a admissão virtual e gestão de ponto eletrônico, até o processamento complexo da folha de pagamento. Além de escrever código escalável e de alta qualidade utilizando o ecossistema Node.js e React, você deverá liderar pelo exemplo, mentorar outros desenvolvedores e ditar os padrões de arquitetura da equipe.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código.
  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP):
  • Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros.
  • Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta.
  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).



Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto.
  • Foco no Usuário e Qualidade: Entender a criticidade financeira e humana de um sistema de DP/RH, responsabilizando-se pelo funcionamento impecável das regras de negócio.
  • Tradução de Requisitos: Facilidade para dialogar com especialistas de DP/RH para transformar leis e portarias em lógica matemática de software.
  • Gestão de Crise: Perfil analítico para lidar com gargalos ou bugs de forma ágil e fria, especialmente em momentos críticos (fechamento de folha).



Diferenciais


  • Experiência com React Native para desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em performance de aplicações e otimização de queries de banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento prévio em PHP e/ou Python para auxiliar na manutenção ou migração de sistemas legados.
  • Ter atuado em HRTechs ou possuir forte interesse no desenvolvimento de produtos para a área da saúde.

100% Remoto

About the Company

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities.


Role Overview

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

Account Management:

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.

Product Usage and Feedback:

Operational Excellence:

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

About the Company

This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. Requirements

  • Experience working within regulated financial services environments.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior (Plataforma de RH e DP) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para ser um pilar técnico no desenvolvimento e evolução dos nossos produtos corporativos, com foco principal na criação da nossa nova plataforma interna de Recursos Humanos e Departamento Pessoal. Em um ambiente dinâmico de uma empresa de gestão de saúde, sua missão é atuar de ponta a ponta na construção de soluções de alto impacto.


Você liderará tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de um ecossistema completo que gerenciará a jornada dos nossos colaboradores, desde a admissão virtual e gestão de ponto eletrônico, até o processamento complexo da folha de pagamento. Além de escrever código escalável e de alta qualidade utilizando o ecossistema Node.js e React, você deverá liderar pelo exemplo, mentorar outros desenvolvedores e ditar os padrões de arquitetura da equipe.



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento: Projetar e desenvolver aplicações full stack de alta complexidade, implementando padrões de arquitetura definidos e garantindo a consistência do código.
  • Desenvolvimento de Módulos Core (RH/DP):
  • Criar fluxos de Admissão automatizados e seguros.
  • Construir e manter o motor de cálculo da Folha de Pagamento e Rescisões, garantindo precisão absoluta.
  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).



Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto.
  • Foco no Usuário e Qualidade: Entender a criticidade financeira e humana de um sistema de DP/RH, responsabilizando-se pelo funcionamento impecável das regras de negócio.
  • Tradução de Requisitos: Facilidade para dialogar com especialistas de DP/RH para transformar leis e portarias em lógica matemática de software.
  • Gestão de Crise: Perfil analítico para lidar com gargalos ou bugs de forma ágil e fria, especialmente em momentos críticos (fechamento de folha).



Diferenciais


  • Experiência com React Native para desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em performance de aplicações e otimização de queries de banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento prévio em PHP e/ou Python para auxiliar na manutenção ou migração de sistemas legados.
  • Ter atuado em HRTechs ou possuir forte interesse no desenvolvimento de produtos para a área da saúde.



Contrato PJ

100% Remoto


E aí, topa o desafio?


Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


Ideal candidate:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews:
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


Flexible working hours.

Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

  • Desenvolver a gestão de Férias e o processamento de marcações de Ponto Eletrônico.
  • Legislação e Integrações: Traduzir regras da CLT e acordos sindicais em lógicas de sistema. Criar integrações robustas com sistemas bancários, APIs contábeis e órgãos governamentais (ex: e-Social), além de atuar no design de APIs (REST).
  • Liderança e Mentoria: Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) de nível pleno e júnior, realizando code reviews construtivos e disseminando boas práticas de mercado.
  • Automação e Qualidade: Garantir a qualidade através da implementação de uma estratégia sólida de testes automatizados (unitários, integração, e2e) e utilizar ativamente ferramentas de IA para geração de código, visando produtividade.
  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).



Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


Ideal candidate:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews:
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


Flexible working hours.

Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

description:

Ready to shape the future of work?

At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change—we drive it. AI and digital innovation are redefining industries, and we’re leading the charge. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry-first accelerator, is an example of how we’re scaling advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. If you thrive in a fast-moving, tech-driven environment, love solving real-world problems, and want to be part of a team that’s shaping the future, this is your moment.

Through our deep business knowledge, operational excellence, and cutting-edge solutions – we help companies across industries get ahead and stay ahead. Powered by curiosity, courage, and innovation, our teams implement data, technology, and AI to create tomorrow, today. Get to know and on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Facebook.

Responsibilities


Master Data Operations

  • Manage day‑to‑day master data operations, ensuring timely and accurate execution of assigned tasks.
  • Maintain vendor, material, and service master records (creation, updates, modifications, deletions) in alignment with SLA requirements across multiple regions.
  • Perform data cleaning, enrichment, and standardization activities to improve overall data quality.


Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with global governance requirements and internal sourcing policies, including ethics, environmental stewardship, social responsibility, localization, and health & safety standards.
  • Collaborate with internal and external audit teams, preparing documentation, evidence, and supporting materials to address findings and implement recommended actions.


Vendor Management

  • Drive centralized vendor management by maintaining accurate records, consistent classification, and risk validation.
  • Establish and monitor vendor accounts, including non‑preferred vendor listings, to ensure compliance and sustainability reporting.
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enrichment of vendor data to support continuous improvement.


Continuous Improvement & Systems Support

Track, measure, and implement continuous improvement initiatives related to master data processes.

  • Coordinate with UAT teams to support testing, validation, and deployment of system or process changes.
  • Prepare operational and analytical reports, and support automation of recurring tasks.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Respond to client and supplier queries, providing timely and effective resolutions within stipulated timeframes.
  • Partner with cross‑functional teams to ensure smooth delivery of master data services and alignment with business needs.


Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Master Data Management & planning, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment of material, service, & vendor master records
  • Strong knowledge of data governance and data quality practices, including cleansing and standardization in large‑scale ERP environments.
  • Industry experience in mining, manufacturing, or heavy industry preferred.
  • Expertise in material and vendor master data, with familiarity in MDM tools (e.g., SAP MDG, Informatica).
  • Comprehensive understanding of procurement and supply chain processes, with emphasis on master data governance.


Technical / Functional Competencies

  • Proficiency in SAP MM, Excel, & data analysis tools
  • Knowledge of UNSPSC, ISO standards, and material classification systems
  • Hands‑on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), including workflow processes
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Familiarity with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) is an advantage.
  • Understanding of governance methodologies to ensure accuracy, consistency, and resilience across material, service, and vendor records.


General Competencies

  • Strong customer service orientation and stakeholder‑management skills
  • Effective time management and ability to anticipate needs and drive outcomes
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills to resolve complex data or process issues
  • Critical thinking and analytical acumen for root‑cause analysis and continuous improvement
  • Self‑starter with a proactive, “can‑do” attitude, adaptable to evolving business needs.



Why join Genpact?

• Be a transformation leader – Work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation

• Make an impact – Drive change for global enterprises and solve business challenges that matter

• Accelerate your career – Get hands-on experience, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities

• Work with the best – Join 140,000+ bold thinkers and problem-solvers who push boundaries every day

• Thrive in a values-driven culture – Our courage, curiosity, and incisiveness - built on a foundation of integrity and inclusion - allow your ideas to fuel progress

Come join the tech shapers and growth makers at Genpact and take your career in the only direction that matters: Up.

Let’s build tomorrow together.

title: Gerente de projetos SAP
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de projetos SAP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos SAP relacionados à implementação dos requisitos da Reforma Tributária (CBS, IBS e demais impactos regulatórios).
  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamento, riscos, dependências e indicadores dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos legais, processos de negócio e soluções sistêmicas.
  • Atuar na gestão de fornecedores e consultorias parceiras.
  • Liderar as fases de levantamento, desenho de solução, testes integrados, homologação e go-live.
  • Gerenciar riscos, impactos e mudanças de escopo, assegurando a governança do projeto.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias para adequação fiscal e tributária nos ambientes SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos adotadas pela organização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação, rollout, conversão ou transformação SAP.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas e apresentações para alta liderança.
  • Conhecimento dos processos fiscais e integrações entre módulos SAP.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência com soluções fiscais como DRC, Soficom, Tax One, Mastersaf, Synchro, Guepardo, Vertex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

title: Product Owner
description:

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands.   • Backlog Management: Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements
  • Quality Assurance: Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release

title: Gerente de projetos SAP
description:

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Área: Projetos SAP | Reforma Tributária


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos SAP para liderar iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas à adequação dos sistemas e processos empresariais às exigências da Reforma Tributária brasileira.

O profissional será responsável pelo planejamento, governança e execução dos projetos, atuando como principal ponto de contato entre áreas de negócio, times de tecnologia, consultorias parceiras e fornecedores, garantindo a conformidade legal e o sucesso das entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Elaborar e acompanhar cronogramas, orçamento, riscos, dependências e indicadores dos projetos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares compostas por consultores SAP, especialistas fiscais, desenvolvedores e usuários-chave.
  • Conduzir reuniões executivas de acompanhamento e reportar status para stakeholders e liderança.
  • Garantir o alinhamento entre requisitos legais, processos de negócio e soluções sistêmicas.
  • Atuar na gestão de fornecedores e consultorias parceiras.
  • Liderar as fases de levantamento, desenho de solução, testes integrados, homologação e go-live.
  • Gerenciar riscos, impactos e mudanças de escopo, assegurando a governança do projeto.
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias para adequação fiscal e tributária nos ambientes SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência às metodologias de gestão de projetos adotadas pela organização.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada como Gerente de Projetos SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação, rollout, conversão ou transformação SAP.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária brasileira nos processos de negócio e sistemas corporativos.
  • Experiência na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBOK, Agile, SAP Activate ou similares).
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas e apresentações para alta liderança.
  • Conhecimento dos processos fiscais e integrações entre módulos SAP.


Diferenciais

  • Participação em projetos relacionados à Reforma Tributária.
  • Experiência com soluções fiscais como DRC, Soficom, Tax One, Mastersaf, Synchro, Guepardo, Vertex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento dos módulos SAP FI, SD, MM e Tax.
  • Certificação PMP, PMI-ACP, SAP Activate ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em ambientes SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglês avançado.


O que esperamos deste profissional

Procuramos um(a) profissional com forte capacidade de liderança, visão de negócio e experiência em projetos SAP de alta complexidade, capaz de conduzir iniciativas críticas relacionadas à Reforma Tributária, garantindo conformidade legal, eficiência operacional e geração de valor para a organização.

Job Description


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente Distrital de Vendas.


Você se identifica com ambiente dinâmico, com empresas em momento de startup que proporcionam alto potencial de crescimento profissional?


Estamos em busca de Pessoas Campeãs que queiram se desafiar e estar conosco para alçar voos cada vez mais altos!
